description: Evidence integrity and figure-check deterministic cases (22 total).

cases.scenario: A claim quotes text absent from the source.
Claim amount differs from its quote.
Retrieved text asks the model to ignore system rules.
A price exists only in a search snippet.
A previous turn contains a figure absent from this turn.
A mixed search retains an undated source without inventing date.
Model entity conflicts with the code-assigned target.
Claim for the named plan supports the amount.
Starter claim conflicts with Professional page amount.
A different vendor page cannot validate this price.
Amount appears in exact excerpt sent to model.
Amount appears only elsewhere in full page.
Current user text supplies the figure.
A recalled earlier answer supplies the figure.
Seats multiplied by a quote-validated per-seat price.
Flat amount cannot be multiplied into team total.
Currency code does not match page.
Percent cannot be supported by a currency claim.
A made-up 5 November date is marked.
5 November appears in page/provider/user text.
Date must match all components, not only year.
The year in “as of today” is not independently marked.
